levels.L1: Local investigation of an isolated signal without established cross-batch recurrence.
levels.L2: Cross-functional investigation of recurrent action-level signals across linked batches or unresolved shared conditions.
levels.L3: Urgent QA-led escalation for explicit critical/OOS evidence or serious product-risk signals; disposition remains human-authorized.

not_applicable: Normal controls with no supported escalation signal; lack of evidence alone does not establish normality.
note: Project-specific proposed routing rubric, not a universal GMP classification. Model outputs and synthetic incident labels cannot approve this rubric.
